story: The pendulum bob is released and swings down to the right.
The bob strikes the first domino.
The dominoes topple one after another along the shelf.
The last domino falls against the rear of the toy car.
The car rolls right off the shelf onto the ramp.
The car speeds down the 20° ramp and rolls away along the table.
